stories.head: True Anomaly raises $190M for co-orbital security
stories.body: True Anomaly secured a $190 million Series C funding round, pushing its valuation to $1.6 billion. The company focuses on co-orbital security and space domain awareness, tapping into the growing DoD interest in safeguarding assets in orbit. With this capital, True Anomaly is positioned to scale operations amid increasing competition in the space security sector.
stories.soWhat: In a world where space is the new battleground, True Anomaly's funding is a clear sign that investors are betting on security over exploration.

stories.head: Space Force doubles down on budget with $69M AI contract
stories.body: The Space Force awarded Slingshot a $69 million contract for AI-enabled training technology, underscoring the military's push for advanced capabilities in space operations. This funding is part of a broader trend, as the FY27 budget markup added $1.4 billion for space resilience, indicating a significant shift in defense spending priorities.
stories.soWhat: When the Space Force starts throwing around budget increases, you know they’re serious about space being the next frontier of military strategy.

stories.head: Swissto12 raises $70M to ramp GEO satellite production
stories.body: Swissto12 has raised $70 million to accelerate production of small GEO satellites, aiming to capture a slice of the lucrative satellite market. This funding round highlights the growing demand for satellite services, particularly in the defense sector, as nations seek to bolster their capabilities in space.
stories.soWhat: Swissto12's move reflects a broader trend where size matters less than the ability to deliver timely satellite services—something the defense sector is keenly aware of.

watchlist.title: Keep an eye on Space Force budget discussions
watchlist.body: With the Space Force's budget doubling in focus, procurement strategies will likely shift significantly in the coming months.

watchlist.title: Watch for more AI contracts in defense
watchlist.body: The success of Slingshot's AI training contract may spur further investments in AI technologies for military applications.

watchlist.title: Swissto12's production ramp-up implications
watchlist.body: The increased production capacity at Swissto12 could impact satellite pricing and availability in both commercial and defense sectors.

watchlist.title: True Anomaly's next strategic moves
watchlist.body: With fresh capital, True Anomaly's next steps will be crucial in defining its role in the co-orbital security landscape.

talent.statLabel: Job orders YoY · plus 2 starters per head, an 8-year first
talent.head: Demand has doubled. So has our hit rate.
talent.body: EVONA's job orders are up 2.0× year-over-year, and for the first time in our eight-year history we're placing two new starters per EVONA staff member. The first number says demand is real. The second says we're converting it, which in recruitment is the only number that actually matters. Growth is heaviest in Series B/C startups; primes are running flat. Compensation isn't the variable. The constraint is schedule risk in the primes: senior engineers leave Boeing, Lockheed, Northrop because they want to ship hardware before retirement.
